Learn more > Team USA's run at the 2026 World Baseball Classic could have ended in disastrous fashion after a stunning loss to Italy in pool play, but the Italian squad's blowout win over Mexico on Wednesday sent the Americans to the quarterfinals.Now, Team USA will face Canada on Friday night with a spot in the semifinal round on the line. The Americans (3-1) finished second in Pool B, while the Canadians (3-1) landed atop the Pool A standings. Can Team USA shake off that recent loss and keep moving toward its ultimate goal? Or will Canada pull off a massive upset?Here is everything you need to know about USA vs. Canada, including TV and streaming options for the game.What Channel Is USA vs. Canada on Tonight?TV channel: FoxLive stream: FuboUSA vs. Canada will air live on Fox.
